# IANA protocol registry snapshot notice

The CSV files in this directory are exact byte snapshots of the IANA protocol registries identified in `manifest.json`.

IANA and the IETF state that the protocol registry data is available under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 dedication. The statement applies to protocol registry data and does not extend to linked RFC documents or unrelated site content.

- License statement: <https://www.iana.org/help/licensing-terms>
- Snapshot date: 2026-07-12
- Integrity: byte count and SHA-256 in `manifest.json`
